caption: A fixed two-point flame arrangement burns against a dim reddish-orange masonry wall, a faint rectangular block visible in the upper-center background. Two thin vertical rods rise from the bottom edge, each crowned by a vertical flame plume, bridged by a bright white-yellow horizontal band in a dumbbell shape. Across the clip this central band steadily thickens, swelling into a broad luminous slab as its white-hot core widens and the edges deform in place. The right-side flame mass grows larger and rounder, while the left vertical column broadens with a more pronounced top plume. Small dark specks drift near the left flame in the latter half. The connected left-plume, bridge, and right-plume structure holds throughout, no part detaching or vanishing.
